scope: Poetry-conditioned Frankl candidates and their documented descendants in this conversation; baseline/control context only where necessary
evidence_warning: Narrative coverage is not full appendix reproduction, proof-assistant verification or expert review. Causal attribution and priority are not established.

poem_draws.author: Edgar Allan Poe
poem_draws.title: To Frances S. Osgood
poem_draws.reported_association: Identity and exactness suggested retaining discrete counts and testing preservation of a probability law.

poem_draws.author: Emily Bronte
poem_draws.title: Come hither, child
poem_draws.reported_association: An isolated chamber and repeated strain suggested local Hall deficits hidden by global abundance.

poem_draws.author: Gerard Manley Hopkins
poem_draws.title: Moonless darkness stands between
poem_draws.reported_association: A persistent anchor suggested the actual largest disjoint member; a vanishing past suggested testing terminal-layer instability.

poem_draws.author: James Tate
poem_draws.title: Dream On
poem_draws.reported_association: An unnoticed absence suggested localizing where empty traces are impossible. Frozen metadata incorrectly named Edward Taylor; the report corrected it.

poem_draws.author: Edgar Allan Poe
poem_draws.title: The Happiest Day
poem_draws.reported_association: Irreversibility suggested reversing the union operation probabilistically through convolution roots.

poem_draws.author: William Blake
poem_draws.title: Spring
poem_draws.reported_association: Individual voices in a common refrain suggested private contributions of irreducible union generators.

poem_draws.author: William Blake
poem_draws.title: Spring
poem_draws.reported_association: A separate repeat draw suggested counting how many pairs produce the same union, rather than crediting generators.

poem_draws.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
poem_draws.title: Moonlight
poem_draws.reported_association: Changed illumination suggested removing automatic union pairs involving the target itself.

attempts.title: Classify negative triple fibres
attempts.status: valid restricted result; duplicated by controls
attempts.original_proposal: Classify all union-closed trace families on a three-element member and use their deficits to force abundance.
attempts.attempt_or_test: The seeded condition classified the negative cases; all three conditions did so independently. The parent checked all 128 top-containing candidate families.
attempts.recorded_outcome: There are 90 union-closed top-containing fibres. Six labelled fibres, in two permutation types, have negative balance, each exactly -1.
attempts.precise_limit: Classification is not a global abundance argument, and was already accessible from the baseline decomposition.
attempts.research_time_saving: Do not claim this shared classification as a poem-specific discovery. A global proof needs control of how many deficits occur.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Parity-sensitive deficit tolerance
attempts.status: valid restricted result; no general bridge
attempts.original_proposal: Retain integer frequencies instead of treating the three-element balance as a continuous average.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Let b count negative fibres and p their total positive compensation. Compare total balance p-b with the largest possible value when all three coordinates are rare.
attempts.recorded_outcome: All-three rarity forces total balance <=-3 for odd m and <=-6 for even m. Hence b-p<3 or <6 respectively suffices for an abundant triple coordinate.
attempts.precise_limit: This supplies a conditional test, not a way to guarantee its hypothesis in an arbitrary family. Integrality also appeared in a control.
attempts.research_time_saving: An inequality with a strict threshold cannot be relaxed to equality without another argument.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Nontrivial union coupling with the original law
attempts.original_proposal: Couple two copies of the uniform family law so their union retains that same law, hoping for a nontrivial entropy route.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Use containment and the identity E|B union C|-E|B|=E|B symmetric-difference C|/2 for equal input laws on a finite universe.
attempts.recorded_outcome: Exact preservation forces B=C almost surely. A nontrivial union coupling cannot preserve the full input law. A total-variation lower bound was also derived.
attempts.precise_limit: This blocks that exact-preservation mechanism, not approximate couplings or the established entropy program.
attempts.research_time_saving: Any repair must explicitly relax distribution preservation and control the resulting error.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Projective-plane obstruction to universal inclusion matching
attempts.original_proposal: Use local upward-closed imbalance to test the proposed injection from coordinate-absent sets to supersets containing that coordinate.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Construct a 29-member complement family from the seven-point projective plane and compute a maximum matching at each coordinate.
attempts.recorded_outcome: Every coordinate occurs in 21/29 members, yet each absent side has eight members and maximum inclusion matching seven. No coordinate supplies the proposed certificate.
attempts.precise_limit: This refutes inclusion-respecting matching, not abundance. The universal monotone-matching direction already had a 2016 counterexample, identified in the later literature correction.
attempts.research_time_saving: Do not try to infer an inclusion-respecting injection merely from global abundance; account for every local Hall constraint.
attempts.verification_in_v05: verify_history.py: explicit 29-set construction and all seven matchings
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Allow a fixed unmatched-source budget
attempts.original_proposal: Repair universal inclusion matching by allowing at most a fixed number of unmatched sources.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Generalize the complement construction using projective planes of prime order q. Pilot03 ordinary follow-up supplied an exact maximum-matching count.
attempts.recorded_outcome: There are 1+(q^2+q+1)2^q sets; the unmatched deficit is 2^q-q-1, unbounded, while coordinate abundance tends to one.
attempts.precise_limit: The general construction and formulas are historical proof claims in the source excerpts; v0.5 directly checks q=2 only. The exact-count follow-up was ordinary work, not a new poem.
attempts.research_time_saving: A universal constant allowance cannot fix the rule. A structural, growing allowance would be a different claim.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Anchor at the actual largest disjoint member
attempts.status: valid criterion; duplicated and related to prior literature
attempts.original_proposal: Replace the whole outside universe by Y, the union of family members actually disjoint from a chosen triple S.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Use missing singleton traces at Y to obtain a nonnegative balance on the complementary pair.
attempts.recorded_outcome: If all three S-elements are rare, the anchor fibre H_Y must be the full triple cube. The structured control independently proved the equivalent statement.
attempts.precise_limit: The full cube alone need not have enough mass to force a globally abundant outside coordinate. Exploration01 identified the broad missing-trace framework as established.
attempts.research_time_saving: Do not repeat the anchor criterion as a new global bridge; its remaining difficulty is quantitative transfer.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: An incomplete terminal fibre forces abundance in S
attempts.original_proposal: Test the earlier unresolved assertion that an incomplete terminal fibre alone forces an abundant coordinate in the selected triple.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Append a fresh greatest member to a triple-deficient example.
attempts.recorded_outcome: The seeded condition gave a 37-member family with triple frequencies18 and terminal fibre {S}; a structured control gave 35/17. The terminal-only implication is false.
attempts.precise_limit: This does not refute the earlier restricted theorem requiring the whole outside universe to be a member. Controls also found the top-extension mechanism.
attempts.research_time_saving: Changing the terminal fibre by a new top layer can preserve the underlying deficiency. The actual anchor carries information that a terminal layer may lose.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Localize deficiency inside S union Y
attempts.status: proved restricted bound; global application stalled
attempts.original_proposal: If every element of a triple S is rare, more than 9m/16 family members lie inside S union Y.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Bound fibre balance by -h/3 generally and by 3h/7 when the empty trace is absent; construct sharp examples.
attempts.recorded_outcome: With I=|{A in F:A subset S union Y}|, max_(x in S) f(x)>=(36m-8I)/63. Deficiency forces I>9m/16. A sequence has m=16q-5, I=9q+9 and triple frequencies8q-3.
attempts.precise_limit: An abundant element in the majority subfamily need not reach half the whole family. The constant is asymptotically sharp; simply improving it indefinitely cannot close the gap.
attempts.research_time_saving: A successful continuation needs cross-union compatibility or a genuine lift of one common coordinate, not just a majority subfamily.
attempts.role: fresh poem-associated proposal; overlaps pre-draw directions
attempts.verification_in_v05: verify_history.py: local inequalities and sharp examples
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Naively lift a core-abundant triple coordinate
attempts.original_proposal: Assume a coordinate abundant inside the localized core remains globally abundant.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Recover a 55-member construction: core45 with triple frequencies(23,20,20), exterior pieces of sizes4 and6.
attempts.recorded_outcome: The full family has triple frequencies(27,27,27), all below half. The inequality f_F(x)>=f_G(x)+|C|/2+|B|/4 is sharp for the initially abundant coordinate.
attempts.precise_limit: Other coordinates remain abundant. The example rejects naive lifting, not Frankl or every stronger transfer condition.
attempts.research_time_saving: Core abundance requires a quantified exterior margin; it cannot be transferred without loss.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Omission-budget bookkeeping
attempts.original_proposal: For core candidates K subset Y, control dilution by counting exterior omissions.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Write sigma_K for total core surplus and M_K=sum_(A in exterior)|K minus A|.
attempts.recorded_outcome: Exact total surplus is sigma_K+|K|O-2M_K. Nonnegativity is a sufficient certificate. Simultaneous dilution demands the opposite strict inequality.
attempts.precise_limit: The identity itself does not exploit union closure and requires the unknown incidence information. No general upper bound on simultaneous omissions was obtained.
attempts.research_time_saving: Restating the desired incidence bound is not a new proof. Supply a structural omission bound before reinvesting.
attempts.novelty: unconfirmed; established ingredients are separately identified

attempts.title: Depth-at-most-two omission transfer
attempts.status: valid restricted theorem; extension to three refuted
attempts.original_proposal: Transfer two core-abundant anchor coordinates when every exterior member omits at most two elements of Y, and try to extend it.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Pair the possible hole {u,v} with the full completion in each outside part; then build nested layers with holes of size up to three.
attempts.recorded_outcome: At depth<=2, f_H(u)+f_H(v)>=|H|. At depth3 a 49-member example has u,v core frequencies8/9 but global frequencies24/49.
attempts.precise_limit: The counterexample has abundant S-elements; it does not settle the additional all-S-rare simultaneous-dilution conjecture.
attempts.research_time_saving: The numerical depth hypothesis cannot simply be removed. Keep the all-S-rare condition separate.

attempts.title: Probabilistic union-convolution roots
attempts.status: novelty gate rejected; positivity also fails
attempts.original_proposal: Mobius-invert fractional powers of the cumulative uniform union law to obtain probabilistic union roots.
attempts.attempt_or_test: Search established random-set theory, then inspect the square root for F={0,3,5,6,7}.
attempts.recorded_outcome: The base construction matches union-infinite divisibility in Molchanov. The unique formal square root for the five-set example has a negative top mass.
attempts.precise_limit: Negative mass blocks a probability experiment, not abundance. No precise literature-distinct Frankl application emerged.
attempts.research_time_saving: Use the established terminology and theory; do not relabel union-infinite divisibility as a new object.
